info.name: SuperAI Flow Platform auth webhook-data API
Submit webhook data for a waiting task

items.docs:
Push data to a flow execution's waiting "Wait for Webhook" task.

The flow pauses when it reaches a webhook receiver task and resumes with
the submitted `data` as the task's output. Data may also be submitted
before the flow reaches the task; it is stored and picked up when the task
runs.

Delivery contract:
    - A 2xx response means the data is durably stored and will not be lost.
    - Retrying with the identical body is safe and idempotent (returns
      status 'duplicate').
    - Retry on 5
